logic: Repeated causally confirmed same-price one-hour pivots form a defended stop cluster; first exceptional-turnover consumption starts outside acceptance continuation versus inside rejection rotation.
pivot_rule: two completed one-hour bars on each side; usable after second right-side bar
cluster_rule: latest two same-side pivots separated >=4 hours and <=5 days; dispersion <=0.10 prior-only ATR20; first pivot must remain close-unconsumed until second pivot availability
event_rule: first later one-hour close >=0.05 ATR20 through cluster boundary with prior-only 168h log-turnover z above pooled calendar-2021 q75
decision_rule: immediately next completed one-hour close; outside=ACCEPT, inside=REJECT
accept_target: nearest still-unconsumed confirmed four-hour pool in break direction
reject_target: frozen equal-pool range base between the two pivot centers
entry_rule: first observed one-minute open strictly later than decision available_at +500ms; cancel when intervening completed minute consumes target, stop or premise
stop_rule: one tick plus 0.10 decision ATR20 beyond full signal/decision excursion
state_exit_rule: first later completed one-hour close through cluster boundary against action, after 500ms
